name: Reconciliation Category 5
definition: Specifies categories of statuses of a derivative when there is a reporting requirement for both counterparties.

ReportingType.name: Reporting Type
ReportingType.definition: Indicator of receiving only one side or both sides of the derivatives.

Pairing.name: Pairing
Pairing.definition: Indicator of side identification of the same derivative.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Indicator if reconciliation of derivatives for which all the reconcilable fields are within the allowed tolerances.

ValuationReconciliation.name: Valuation Reconciliation
ValuationReconciliation.definition: Indicator if reconciliation of derivatives for which all the reconcilable fields are within the allowed tolerances.

Revived.name: Revived
Revived.definition: Indicator of derivative reopening, terminated or cancelled by mistake.

FurtherModification.name: Further Modification
FurtherModification.definition: Indicator of modification to the terms or details of a previously reported derivative, at a trade or position level.
